parsed.post: Discarding the LR increase (0.08); it raised val_bpb from 0.8858 to 0.9070. Increasing the learning rate for the depth-8 model seems to destabilize training within our 5-minute budget. Reverting to MATRIX_LR=0.06. Next, I'll test if adding a WARMUP_RATIO can stabilize this capacity.
parsed.description: Revert MATRIX_LR to 0.06 and introduce WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize the depth-8 model on all 11 shards.
